researcher_notes: Part 2 of the Toyota group (part 1 = docs/research_findings_opus_20260808_toyota_part1.json). Two remaining files: tae500-technicky-list-003.pdf (Autopilot towing truck TAE500, Tugger AGV) and tmha_sai125cb_brochure.pdf (Autopilot stacker truck SAI125CB, Forklift AGV). Both are VDI 2198 Typenblatt sheets. NOTE on the SAI125CB brochure's publisher: it is issued by Toyota Material Handling AUSTRALIA (8 Secombe Place, Moorebank NSW 2170), not TMH Europe — the DB company row is 'Toyota Material Handling Europe'. Same truck and same VDI data, but the sheet is not evidence of European availability; service_coverage was NOT touched. DELIBERATE DEVIATION FROM BLANKET VARIANT-SPLITTING on the SAI125CB: the sheet has two side-by-side columns (3.7 m Triplex Hi-Lo / 5.4 m Triplex Hi-Lo) but VDI row 1.2 'Model' reads SAI125CB in BOTH columns — this is one model with two mast options, not two models. Splitting it would fabricate a model designation that Toyota does not print. Recorded as one product with the mast axis documented in notes. (Contrast: the SAE160 in part 1 was split because its two columns carry genuinely different mast-type designations.) The TAE500 sheet is dated 2018 (749993-040, version 3, 2018-05-21, p.4) — old enough to warrant a currency check before import.

products.notes: SPEED — the sheet gives four different speeds and AP0 has one field. Manual mode 6,0/11,0 km/h (loaded/unloaded, i.e. 3.06 m/s unloaded max); Auto mode with automatic towing pin 6,0/8,0 km/h; Auto mode with MANUAL towing pin only 6,0/6,0 km/h (1.67 m/s). Recorded the automatic-mode, automatic-pin, unloaded figure (2.22 m/s) because this is an AGV and that matches the existing DB value exactly. A buyer specifying the manual-pin option gets 1.67 m/s. COUPLING — a third option, 'Towing ball Ø50mm' (p.2, row 4.12), is printed but has no clean AP0 allowed value ('Towbar' is the nearest; 'Pintle Hook' is wrong). Not mapped; flagged instead. MAX_TRAILERS — NOT stated anywhere in this document. The DB holds 4; that value is not confirmed or contradicted here, left untouched. NOT MAPPED (no AP0 field): rated drawbar pull 1150 N / maximum drawbar pull 3500 N (row 1.7) — this is the physically meaningful towing-capability figure for a tractor and is arguably more useful than the 5000 kg rated load; wheelbase 1319 mm (1.9); service weight without battery 855 kg (2.1); overall height without scanner 2257 mm and with navigation scanner 2392/2969 mm (4.2.1) — AP0 has no vehicle-height field for Tuggers; stand height 130 mm (4.8); ground clearance 62/71 mm (4.32) — deliberately NOT written to min_ground_clearance, which is AMR-scope and per its AP0 hint means ROBOT HEIGHT, not the chassis gap; drive motor rating 2,8 kW (6.1); battery weight 338/538 kg (6.5); sound level 65,7 dB(A) (8.4); drive control 'BT Powerdrive' (8.1); clear width driver compartment entrance 450 mm (4.44). AISLE WIDTH — neither min_aisle_width nor tugger_min_aisle_width is stated; per the AP0 hint ('If no explicit aisle width is stated → output null') both left null. SAFETY — p.4 lists personal safety protection in drive direction and along sides (standard), in reverse direction (optional), and obstacle detection front/top (optional); no PL/SIL level, no ISO 3691-4 reference, no scanner count, so functional_safety_level, safety_standard and safety_coverage all left null. Obstacle DETECTION is not obstacle BYPASS — autonomous_obstacle_bypass left untouched (DB has 1).

products.notes: MAST CONFIGURATION AXIS (collapsed, documented): the two columns differ only in mast. 3.7 m column — lift height h23 3700, lift movement h3 3660, free lift h2 1238, height mast lowered h1 1802, height mast extended h4 4224, service weight 3300 kg. 5.4 m column — h23 5400, h3 5358, h2 1804, h1 2368, h4 5922, service weight 3415 kg. Everything else (payload, footprint, speeds, gradeability, battery, wheels, turning radius) is identical. Recorded the 5.4 m figures as the model's maximum capability, matching the existing DB value of 5400. MIN_TOTAL_HEIGHT — deliberately NOT taken from row '4.2 Height, mast lowered h1' (1802 / 2368 mm), because on this truck the NAVIGATION SCANNER MAST, not the fork mast, sets the true overall height: 2430 mm minimum (row h20, three scanner options 2430/2750/2970). 2430 > 2368, so the scanner figure governs in both mast variants. A reviewer taking h1 would understate the truck by 62-628 mm on a KO_IF_GT field. PAYLOAD DERATING (matrix, NOT collapsed into max_payload): p.3 'Lift capacities / Actual Capacity (kg)' gives payload as a function of lift height x load centre — at LC 650 mm: 3800 mm -> 1250 kg, 4300 -> 1150, 4800 -> 1000, 5400 -> 900. At LC 850 mm the 5400 mm figure falls to 650 kg. So the rated 1250 kg is only available up to ~3800 mm. Recorded max_payload = 1250 (VDI row 1.5, matching the DB) rather than the conservative 900, because 1250 is the printed rated capacity and overriding it would contradict row 1.5 — but a buyer needing 1250 kg AT 5.4 m would be wrongly matched. Flagged for the Tech Lead: AP0 has no payload-vs-lift-height derating field. MIN_AISLE_WIDTH MATRIX (collapsed, documented): p.3 gives six cells along a fork-length x load-footprint axis — FL650/600x800 -> 2404; FL850/800x1200 -> 2677; FL1050/1000x1200 -> 2851; FL1250/1200x800 -> 2963; FL1350/1200x1000 -> 2994; FL1400/1200x1200 -> 3032. Chose the FL1250 / 1200x800 EUR-pallet cell (2963) rather than the strict worst case (3032), because 2963 is the standard-EUR-pallet configuration and matches p.2's headline column (overall length 2621 = the FL1250 cell). The DB's 3000 is evidently the rounded product-page figure ('3m rack aisle') for the same measurement — NOT flagged as a conflict, but recommend replacing it with the exact 2963. Conservative alternative if the buyer uses 1200x1200 loads: 3032 mm. LIFT HEIGHT IN AUTOMATIC MODE — footnote 1) on p.2: 'Max height of load station in automode is h23 - 200mm', i.e. the usable automatic drop height is 5200 mm, not 5400. Same footnote as the part-1 Toyota trucks; still needs one ruling for the whole Autopilot range. DRIVE_TYPE NOT CHANGED, but flagged as internally ambiguous: the DB holds 'Counterbalanced' and the model suffix is 'CB', yet this VDI table repeatedly uses support-arm terminology — '3.1 Drive/Support arm wheel', '2.2 Axle load ... Drive/Support arm wheel', '4.26 Distance between support arms b4 665'. Evidence FOR counterbalanced (and why it was left alone): service weight 3300-3415 kg for a 1250 kg truck, length to face of forks l2 = 1371 mm, and an auto-mode aisle width of 2963 mm for an 800 mm-deep load — all three are counterbalance geometry, not straddle geometry. Reads as VDI-template boilerplate rather than a real straddle chassis. VEHICLE_LENGTH — 2621 mm is the FL1250 cell; the full range is 2021-2771 mm (2063-2813 with the fork tip stopping device), p.3. NOT MAPPED (no AP0 field): free lift h2 1238/1804 mm (row 4.3) — a genuinely differentiating figure for low-headroom stacking, and free_lift_open_closed_pallet is a BOOLEAN in AMR scope so it cannot hold it; turning radius Wa 1321 mm (row 4.35) — the recurring Forklift-scope gap, explicit label; lift speed 0.17/0.31 m/s and lowering speed 0.40/0.44 m/s (rows 5.2/5.3); fork dimensions 40/100 mm, 70/162 mm with safety bumper (4.22); width over forks 450/500/570/620 mm (4.25); ground clearance 39 mm below sensors / 33 mm centre of wheelbase (4.31/4.32) — again NOT written to min_ground_clearance; drive motor 2.5 kW, lift motor 3 kW (6.1/6.2); battery weight 260 kg (6.5); sound level <70 dB(A) (8.4); laser product safety Class 1 (EC 60825-1). SPEED DIRECTION DEPENDENCE (same pattern as the part-1 Toyota trucks): automatic mode is 7.9 km/h in drive-wheel direction but only 4.7 km/h in fork direction WITH personnel protection (PPS) and 1.1 km/h in BOTH directions WITHOUT PPS (rows 5.1.1-5.1.3); maintenance mode is 2.5 km/h. AP0's single max_speed hides a 7x spread. SAFETY — p.4 lists personal safety protection in drive direction, along sides and in fork direction (all standard) plus optional top and front obstacle detection and an optional mechanical fork bumper. No PL/SIL level and no ISO 3691-4 reference appear, so functional_safety_level and safety_standard were left null (the DB's ISO 3691-4 and Single plane (2D) are not sourced from this document). FORKS_FREE_FLOATING — the DB holds 1 with a product-page quote; this document neither confirms nor contradicts it, left untouched. LOAD_DETECTION 'Mechanical/Tactile' is inferred from the phrase 'fork tip sensors'; if a reviewer considers that too loose, drop it and keep only Barcode/DataMatrix + RFID (both explicitly named, both optional).
